title: Love Island Text
blurb: "I've got a text!" This is the alert that governs life inside the Love Island villa, and the collective scream it triggers arrives immediately behind. In the show it means the producers are about to detonate something. Online it means the same thing anywhere else. What makes it useful is the timing: the sound lands before anyone knows what the message actually says, so you get suspense with no content attached. Play it when a message arrives that will change everything. The results, the reply, the "we need to talk".
origin: The dramatic text-arrival sound from Love Island UK.
